title: CISA Flags LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin Flaw Exploited for Root Privilege Escalation
summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added a security flaw impacting LiteSpeed cPanel Plugin to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, requiring Federal Civilian Executive Branch (FCEB) agencies to apply the fixes by June 18, 2026.

title: Chinese Hackers Abused Google Workspace Rules to Steal Research and Defense Emails
summary: A China-linked espionage group hid inside North American medical, academic, and military research networks for more than a year, quietly stealing sensitive research and defense email.
card_summary: A China-linked espionage group hid inside North American medical, academic, and military research networks for more than a year, quietly stealing sensitive research and defense email.

sections.technical: The way in was a backdoor on their REDCap research servers that stole login credentials.
